title: Electronic Notebook: Anisotropic protein-protein interactions in dilute and concentrated solutions
description: Electronic notebooks (Jupyter), simulation input and output, and experimental SAXS data for reproducing the results in Pasquier et al., Anisotropic protein-protein interactions in dilute and concentrated solutions, J. Colloid Interface Sci. (2022). Covers salt excess chemical potentials, two-body potentials of mean force and second virial coefficients, and many-body structure factors from Metropolis Monte Carlo simulations of Thermomyces lanuginosus lipase. Version 2 adds a uv-managed Python environment, documents data formats and units, and makes all analysis notebooks run from a clean checkout. Code: MIT; data: CC-BY-4.0.
